title: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each se
question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.

prediction.sql:
WITH team_points AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
        WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS points
  FROM Match m
  GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, m.home_team_api_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
        WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS points
  FROM Match m
  GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, m.away_team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    league_id,
    country_id,
    team_api_id,
    points,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY season, league_id, country_id
      ORDER BY points DESC, team_api_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM team_points
)
SELECT
  t.team_long_name AS team_name,
  l.name AS league,
  c.name AS country,
  r.points AS total_points
FROM ranked r
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.season, l.name, c.name;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH team_points AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
        WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS points
  FROM Match m
  JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, t.team_long_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
        WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS points
  FROM Match m
  JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  GROUP BY m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, t.team_long_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    season, league_id, country_id, team_name, points,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id, country_id ORDER BY points DESC, team_name) AS rn
  FROM team_points
)
SELECT
  r.team_name,
  l.name AS league,
  c.name AS country,
  r.points
FROM ranked r
JOIN League l ON r.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON r.country_id = c.id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.season, l.name, c.name;
